As the weather turns cooler and the peak season for autumn outdoor activities arrives, I usually tweak my daily carry list to suit how I spend my time. If you want a tough wallet that can handle the outdoors while still working for everyday use, the Pelican MagSafe Wallet with Card Case is my top pick.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest and most eye-catching products in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Built for the outdoors

The Pelican wallet carries an IPX4 water-resistance rating, meaning even if you get it wet on a hike or by the lake, your credit cards and cash inside stay dry. Once it clicks shut, everything is locked in securely. Take me as an example: in autumn I often go watch the Falcons play, and even when I head to an American football game, I like knowing all my belongings are tucked away and secured. That alone is enough to make it a dependable choice for autumn outings, since the weather can be so unpredictable this time of year. The feel of it is less like a wallet and more like a small hard-shell protective case that happens to magnetically snap onto the back of your iPhone.

Most MagSafe wallets on the market are only designed to hold a few cards, but Pelican's design is far more accommodating. It easily fits ID and credit cards, with room for a small amount of folded cash and a slim key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet already covers the basics without needing to carry an extra bag.

Although the Pelican wallet is geared toward outdoor use, it works just as well as an everyday carry. The strong magnet holds it firmly against the back of the iPhone, and once it clicks shut, nothing falls out. Compared with less durable MagSafe wallets, this one sacrifices a bit of slimness in exchange for greater peace of mind. If I'm after a more minimalist design in summer, it may not be my first pick; but for hiking, American football games, or any occasion where I'll be outdoors and the weather could change, it's the right call. It's also a great MagSafe wallet for a kid who's just gotten their first iPhone. My older boy has already been using one for a couple of years.

Pelican MagSafe Wallet: the verdict

The Pelican MagSafe Wallet is made for people who value durability. It shields your essentials from the weather and moisture, holds enough for a hike or a day out, and clicks securely into place. If you want a MagSafe wallet that keeps working after a drop and still works for daily life, this is the one.

You can buy the Pelican MagSafe Wallet directly from Amazon or the Pelican website.
